scripts.init:db: mkdir -p data && DATABASE_URL=sqlite:./data/members.db point launch src/app.point init database
scripts.build:point: point build-ts src/app.point generated/app.ts && point build-js src/app.point generated/app.js
scripts.build:manual: npm run build:point && npm run build:ui
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve
